copy.tagline: 集成 Discord 机器人频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Discord 机器人消息通道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add a Discord bot channel to your application.

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 能通过 Discord 与你聊天。你可以在 Discord 私信或服务器频道中与 Claude 对话，它会接收并回复消息。
howto.when: 当你按照步骤创建 Discord 机器人、安装适配器并配置凭证后，Claude 即可在 Discord 私信或服务器频道中与你交流。

say.text: 在 Discord 私信中回复我。
在 #announcements 频道发一条公告。
say.note: Claude 会向指定服务器频道发送消息。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can interact with you through Discord. You can chat with Claude in Discord direct messages or server channels; it will receive and respond to messages.
howto.when_en: After you follow the steps to create a Discord bot, install the adapter, and configure credentials, Claude can reply to you via Discord DMs or server channels.

say_en.text: Reply to me in Discord DM.
say_en.note: Claude will send a response via your Discord bot's DM.

say_en.text: Post an announcement in the #announcements channel.
say_en.note: Claude will send a message to the specified server channel.
